description: Source code for Bluetooth USB class implementation in Zephyr OS, handling USB communication, threads, and Bluetooth HCI data transfer.

methods.name: bt_h4_read
methods.description: Handles reading data from the USB endpoint and initiating subsequent reads.

methods.name: hci_tx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for transmitting Bluetooth HCI data over USB.

methods.name: hci_rx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for receiving Bluetooth HCI data from USB and sending to Bluetooth driver.

methods.name: bt_h4_status_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling USB device status changes.

methods.name: bt_h4_vendor_handler
methods.description: Handles vendor-specific USB requests (not supported in this implementation).

methods.name: bt_h4_interface_config
methods.description: Configures the USB interface with the given interface number.

methods.name: bt_h4_init
methods.description: Initializes the Bluetooth H4 USB class, sets up threads and raw Bluetooth channel.
